documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter/Half Year Ended 30 September 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Management noted strong performance in the second half of fiscal year 2026, led by significant volume growth and new customer additions in the water business. However, they highlighted cost pressures from rising raw material prices, particularly metals like zinc and molybdenum, which have negatively impacted profit margins in the current period. The company continues to focus on geographical expansion, product innovation, and maintaining tight credit policies across all business units. Furthermore, management remains optimistic about the long-term demand outlook while navigating near-term margin challenges. Management reported a consolidated revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

guidance.claim: Management expects H2 to grow at a steady rate in the water business unit.
guidance.quote: So we hope H2 would be we also be growing at a steady rate.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the revenue outlook continues to remain positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive.

demand_outlook.claim: The company notes that sales growth outlook looks positive across all business units.
demand_outlook.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates a volume growth of around 15% to 20% in construction chemicals for quarter one.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

demand_outlook.claim: Management projects a volume growth of roughly around 10% for water chemicals.
demand_outlook.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a robust enquiry pipeline for Water Technologies.
Management reported 18 percent stronger demand in Construction Chemicals for HY2 2025-26 versus HY1 2025-26.
Management reported that Construction Chemicals activity picked up post monsoon following a prolonged monsoon.
demand_outlook.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
demand_outlook.quote: our outlook remains positive across all business units. That is construction, chemical distribution and cleaning and hygiene.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported improved margins driven by lower raw material costs and newer product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies

margins_costs.claim: Management highlighted a 15 percent increase in raw material price and slow growth in Q2 for Construction Chemicals.
margins_costs.quote: Construction Chemicals 15% Increase in RM price and slow growth in Q2

margins_costs.claim: Management noted material costs increase due to war impact and some volatility in metal compounds.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased in Q2 on account of good gross margins and improved cost optimization.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased on account of good, good gross margins what we had and improved cost optimization.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated PBT for Q2 improved due to lower raw material cost and new product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated PBT for second quarter 25-26 was at Rs. 9.62 crores, again up by 6% as compared to last quarter. So improved margins were on account of lower raw material cost and new product technologies which we brought in

margins_costs.claim: Higher EBITDA and PBT for the half year were mainly due to improved margins from lower raw material cost and introduced product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: So higher in EBITDA and PBT is mainly on account of improved margins because of lower raw material cost and the product technologies which were introduced in this half year

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that material costs and gross profit margins are stable.
margins_costs.quote: our material cost, our gross profit margins are stable.

orders_capacity.claim: The company enters the new financial year with a strong order book for the chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: Management highlighted a strong order book for specialty chemicals in the Water BU.
orders_capacity.quote: Strong order book for specialty chemicals

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported equipment and systems deliveries on schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment and systems deliveries on schedule

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the Water Technologies business had a 36 percent stronger order book in HY2 compared to HY1.
The water business unit has a strong order book and a healthy ongoing enquiry pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: This is on account of strong order booking what we have received in current Financial year also we have a healthy enquiry pipeline which is ongoing.

orders_capacity.claim: The water business unit has almost Rs. 100 plus crores of new order book apart from regular business.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as the order booking is concerned in the water business unit we have almost 100 plus cr. of new order book which is apart from the regular business.

orders_capacity.claim: The Rs. 100 plus crore order book in the water business includes almost Rs. 85 to 90 crores in chemicals and Rs. 10 to 12 crores in equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: We have almost Rs. 100 plus CR order book which includes chemical as well as equipment’s almost Rs. 85 to Rs. 90 CR is in the chemical’s domain and Rs. 10 Cr. to Rs. 12 Cr. is in the equipment’s domain.

capital_allocation.claim: Management maintains a tight credit policy for construction chemicals with day sales outstanding around 88 days.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted steady revenue growth with a tight credit policy for Construction Chemicals.
capital_allocation.quote: Steady revenue growth with tight credit policy

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that material costs started increasing from late February and March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management reported a challenging period following the war declaration with limited surplus inventories and the need to ration them.
risks_headwinds.quote: And post-war declaration, it was a very challenging period. We had limited inventories of surplus inventories but had to ration them across customers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited a prolonged monsoon affecting Construction Chemicals activity.
risks_headwinds.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

risks_headwinds.claim: Management mentioned material costs increase due to war impact along with volatility in metal compounds.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

risks_headwinds.claim: Sales in Q2 were down due to downward trends in construction chemicals, distribution, and cleaning and hygiene.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was down as compared to Second quarter 24-25 by 3% so this down was account of construction chemicals distribution and cleaning hygiene, showing a downward trend.

risks_headwinds.claim: Marginal decrease in half year consolidated revenue was due to construction chemicals and distribution segments going down.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this marginal decrease was on account of construction chemicals and distribution segment distribution business unit going down.

management_commitments.claim: Management noted that post demerger compliances are on track with records being updated.
management_commitments.quote: Post demerger compliances are on track, records being updated

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to invoice 50% of the new water business order book in the 3rd and 4th quarters.
management_commitments.quote: So that's this order book more or less would be invoiced 50% of them in 3rd, 3rd and fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to invoice about 40 to 50% of the new order book within the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So that's how we look at almost invoicing almost around 40 to 50% of this order in within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management internally looks at about four years to hit the 1000 crore revenue milestone.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we're looking at about four years odd to hit 1000 crore milestone, how well it gets achieved.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
